gates.name: MUDA-waste-audit
gates.repair_instruction: Run `bash super-gsd/scripts/sgsd-muda-audit.sh --phase {N}` and address findings in `.planning/phases/{N}/WASTE.md`; rerun until WARN-or-PASS.

gates.name: classifier-haiku
gates.repair_instruction: Legacy gate name. Derive classifier result from plan frontmatter/cache or run Codex/local classify; do not spawn Haiku/Sonnet.

gates.name: context-selector-haiku
gates.repair_instruction: Legacy gate name. Derive sgsd_recall_queries from plan evidence and retry with broader recall terms if empty.

gates.name: intent-injection
gates.repair_instruction: Re-compose the dispatch prompt and re-inject the intent block from the plan frontmatter; verify the agent received it via the dispatch report's INTENT echo.

gates.name: per-dispatch-ATC
gates.repair_instruction: Read the latest commit-reviews.jsonl row in `.planning/phases/{N}/`, address the CRIT verdict, re-commit, and re-dispatch the executor to refire ATC.

gates.name: phase-level-ATC
gates.repair_instruction: Read `.planning/milestones/{ms}/phases/{NN}-*/{NN}-ATC-REVIEW.md`. Address each WARN/CRIT in a follow-up commit; re-run gsd-verifier to refire phase-level-ATC.

gates.name: qualitative-waste-audit
gates.repair_instruction: Re-dispatch sgsd-code-reviewer with --qualitative-waste against the latest WASTE.md; address findings in a follow-up commit.

gates.name: sgsd-curate-learnings
gates.repair_instruction: Run `bash super-gsd/scripts/sgsd-curate.sh` to write learnings under `.planning/memory/`; verify with `grep -r '<pattern>' .planning/memory/`.

gates.name: sgsd-recall-queries
gates.repair_instruction: Run `bash super-gsd/scripts/sgsd-recall.sh '<query>'` for each recall term in the plan; if memory tree empty, mark dispatch as cold-start and continue.

gates.name: token-log
gates.repair_instruction: Append the missing token row to `.planning/metrics/token-log.jsonl` from the dispatch report; re-run the milestone token reconciliation script.

gates.name: verifier-detail-vs-summary
gates.repair_instruction: Reconcile detail rows with the summary block in `{N}-VERIFICATION.md`; either expand the summary or delete the orphan detail rows; re-run verifier.

gates.name: verifier-row-arithmetic
gates.repair_instruction: Open `.planning/phases/{N}/{N}-verify.mjs`, fix the row-count mismatch (expected vs actual), and re-run `node {N}-verify.mjs`.

gates.name: vtp-enrichment
gates.repair_instruction: Run `node super-gsd/scripts/lib/vtp-enrichment-gate.cjs --phase {N}`; if VTP api_error, fall back per fallback-chain (sgsd-memory) and log provider_unavailable.
